{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the response rate by sex
print("Response rate by sex:")
response_by_sex = trial_df.groupby('sex')['responded'].mean().round(3)
print(response_by_sex)

# Check the response rate by arm
print("\nResponse rate by arm:")
response_by_arm = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean().round(3)
print(response_by_arm)

# Check the response rate by sex within each arm
print("\nResponse rate by sex within each arm:")
response_by_sex_arm = trial_df.groupby(['arm', 'sex'])['responded'].mean().round(3)
print(response_by_sex_arm)"}
